subject: BridgeCast dedicated activation & sizing validation
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@bridgecast.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: BridgeCast Procurement <procure@bridgecast.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production spikes — request to move to Dedicated capacity

Hi Priyom,

We talked last week about the unpredictable traffic bursts we saw during the September campaign. Our platform is sensitive to tail latency, and the hosted plan's throttling is starting to affect SLAs with one of our customers.

Can Redwood help us move a portion of our footprint to Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput? We captured a 48-hour telemetry export (attached: bridgecast-throughput-telemetry-20260912.csv) showing peak concurrency, median token/sec, and 99th pct latency across routes.

As a commercial ask, we'd like:
- A sizing recommendation (baseline and headroom) tied to that telemetry
- A proposed cutover timeline (dry-run, canary, full swap) in the next 3–4 weeks
- Any procurement lead times, acceptance gates, and a simple SLA draft we can review

Cc'ing procurement so they see timing constraints. We have internal sign-off to proceed quickly if the numbers align.

Thanks — looking for a short call this week to kick off validation.

— Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Platform
BridgeCast
elena@bridgecast.ai
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@bridgecast.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spikes — request to move to Dedicated capacity

Elena — thanks for the telemetry, this is exactly what we need. Quick read: short, high-concurrency bursts (10–12k concurrent tokens/minute across two routes) with 99th pct spikes that exceed your contract SLOs.

Suggested next steps (short):
1) Kickoff call to align scope — 30 minutes (this week). I can do Wed/Thu afternoon PT.
2) Redwood will run a sizing validation in our staging cluster using your export as traffic replay. Goal: confirm a Dedicated profile that meets 99th pct latency target with 20% headroom.
3) Staged cutover timeline: rehearsal -> canary (5% traffic) -> ramp (25% -> 100%) over a 48–72 hour window.

Initial sizing hypothesis (subject to validation): a reserved pool equivalent to 6x A100-80GB (or quantized equivalent) with continuous batching and prefix caching should cover baseline plus headroom for your current peaks. Validation will confirm exact GPU count and autoscale policy.

I've attached a rehearsal calendar invite (cutover-playbook-rehearsal.ics) and pulled the SLA draft into the shared Drive link.

Marissa and Kimberly — can you own commercial & Po procurement sequencing?
Karthik — can your infra team own the replay/sanity stress window next week?

I'll schedule the kickoff after I hear back on availability.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: BridgeCast validation plan + acceptance matrix (internal)

Team — summary & action items for the sizing validation run:

Overview
- Use BridgeCast telemetry replay (attached CSV) against staging Dedicated nodes to validate:
  * 99th pct token latency < 350ms for both routes
  * Throughput sustain of 10k tokens/min for 3 sustained minutes without queueing
  * Cold-start KV cache warming time < 30s

Test matrix & windows
- Day 0 (prep): ingest telemetry, verify data mapping, provision 6x A100-equivalent pool (quantized fallback enabled)
- Day 1 (replay): 3 x 10-minute high-concurrency replays separated by 30m; collect latency, CPU/GPU util, queue depth, tokens/sec
- Day 2 (stress): 1 x 30m sustained ramp to 1.5x peak to test autoscale thresholds and circuit-breaker behavior

Acceptance gates (must all pass for canary):
- Perf: 99th pct latency target + <10% variance across runs
- Stability: no OOMs, <1% error rate, and KV cache hit-rate > 70% after warmup
- Ops: Canary rollback playbook validated (hooks & fallback model variant tested)

Data collection & deliverables
- kpi_snapshot.csv (perf), perf-trace.zip (traces), and cutover-playbook.md (rehearsal checklist).
- Owner: Karthik (run), Priyom (validation & artifacts), Marissa/Kimberly (commercial acceptance).

Questions for planning call
- Procurement lead time (expected PO + legal turnaround) — Marissa/Kimberly
- Any region constraints? (BridgeCast prefers us-west-2) — tagged for Karthik

I'll schedule the replay for next Tue/Wed 09:00–12:00 PT unless objections.

— Priyom
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@bridgecast.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: BridgeCast Procurement <procure@bridgecast.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeCast dedicated activation & sizing validation

Elena — good to connect. Quick commercial notes before we start validation:

- We can reserve the 6x pool described for validation; production commit pricing will be set after the validation artifacts (expected delta < 10% in GPU count).
- For customers moving from Hosted to Dedicated we typically require a 30–45 day provisioning window for reserved hardware in us-west-2; short bursts can be supported with burst-capacity policy in the meantime.
- Attached is an SLA draft (BridgeCast-SLA-Draft-v3.pdf) with a targeted 99.9% uptime SLA and latency SLO language — we've left a clause for partner-specific penalties (editable).

Procurement: Elena, your procurement team can sign the initial engagement via DocuSign (link below). Once we confirm the validation pass, the final PO + reserved commitment will be queued for capacity allocation.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/BRG-2026-091-SLA
PO lead time estimate: 2–3 business days after legal clearance; provisioning clock starts after PO is received and deposit cleared.

If BridgeCast needs a faster runway, we can run a transient dedicated pilot (short-term reserved hours) while the reserved procurement completes — flag if you'd like that route.

— Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Elena Soto <elena@bridgecast.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: BridgeCast Procurement <procure@bridgecast.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeCast dedicated activation & sizing validation

Team — thanks for the clarity and the plan. BridgeCast approves:
- Proceed with the staging replay next Tue 09:00 PT (we will make sure credentials/traffic mapping are ready).
- We accept the 6x A100-equivalent starting point for the replay and understand sizing will be finalized after validation artifacts.
- Procurement will route the initial DocuSign this week; they expect PO within 3 business days.

Two quick asks before the replay:
1) Share a short onboarding doc for our SREs so they can attend the rehearsal with the right credentials and playback hooks.
2) Confirm the rollback window and canary throttle percentages in writing (we want the explicit canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h unless a gate fails).

We also attached an internal note (procurement) asking for any compliance/additional paperwork — I'll forward if needed.

Look forward to the replay.

— Elena
